content:
B"H

# Better Pass — Completion Gate

The Awtsmoos renews every apparent success before a finite report can name the work complete;
Awtsmoos.com may call this mission finished only when source, tests, browser, Git, deployment, and production all agree in one verified beat.

## Completion Evidence Required

- All mission source/tests stay below the configured line ceiling and use tabs where indentation is valid.
- All new Portal tests pass.
- Existing relevant tests still pass.
- Local `/api/portal` root, type, collection, and API-family routes return expected JSON.
- Local `/apps/` loads without site-owned module/MIME/runtime errors.
- Local `/portal/` loads without site-owned console/network/runtime errors.
- Mobile/tablet/desktop/cinema audit findings are empty or intentionally documented.
- Every newly exposed untracked source file is classified; secrets/generated/local-only artifacts are excluded.
- Git diff is reviewed in full enough to understand every released category.
- Canonical branch push succeeds and remote SHA matches local SHA.
- Real deployment mechanism succeeds.
- Production `foundation.js` returns JavaScript rather than 404.
- Production Apps CompactJS returns JavaScript rather than JSON ENOENT.
- Production `/apps/` browser console is clean of site-owned errors.
- Production `/portal/` and `/api/portal` are directly reachable and clean.

## Embarrassment Gate

Before final response, ask what the user would immediately notice if they opened `/apps/` on a phone and `/portal/` on a desktop. Any obvious failure, awkward overflow, naked native control, stale asset, broken deep-link, or console error creates more work.

## NEXT_ACTION

Execute the test/readback/mechanical checks now; do not write a final response while any required evidence above is missing.
